changes_if_approved.from: 家族与条件额度已激活

evidence_for.quote: One model and one Adam(lr3e-4,betas.9/.999,eps1e-8,weight_decay0), no clipping/entropy/teacher/critic.
evidence_for.why: 真实学习且四角色比较能区分初始结构、学习增量和就近差距。

evidence_against.quote: Strongest support is previous actual native learning; strongest contrary evidence is nearest deficits and service/F dissociation.
evidence_against.why: 结构配额匹配和参数少都不能保证新方法服务或成本。

uncertainty: 单fit条件观察；完整新速度、graph内存和实际support覆盖尚未知。
